evals.prompt: Make a 15-minute deck for the engineering all-hands from report.md. It's a CI wall-clock report with before/after tables, a job graph, and a list of open caveats.
evals.expected_output: An outline table presented for approval before any HTML exists, then an index.html of about nine slides where every content slide is an eyebrow, a claim headline, and one visual, with the report's explanations in speaker notes.
assertions: The outline table (layout, eyebrow, headline, visual) is shown and approval is awaited before the deck is built
Every headline is a claim of seven words or fewer, not a topic label
No slide carries a sub-headline, paragraph, or bullet list outside <aside class="notes">
Before/after tables become stat strips, big numbers, or create-diagram charts rather than HTML tables
scripts/check_deck.py exits 0 on the final deck

evals.prompt: Turn these notes into slides: our ingestion service reads from Kafka, validates claims, writes to Postgres, and publishes an event to the pricing service. Add a slide on how the retry queue works.
evals.expected_output: Both the service flow and the retry queue are drawn by architecture-design:create-diagram at the slide-body preset under the Machinify profile, exported to SVG, and inlined; no diagram is built from HTML boxes or hand-written SVG.
assertions: architecture-design:create-diagram is invoked once per diagram
Each request to create-diagram names the slide-body preset, the machinify profile, and no in-diagram title
A .diagram-design marker containing exactly 'profile: machinify' exists in the deck directory
Every inline <svg> has a root id ending in -root, a first-child <title>, and a <desc>
The diagram HTML sources are kept in <deck-dir>/diagrams/

evals.prompt: Here's my outline for a customer update. Slide 3: 'Q3 platform reliability improvements and what they mean for your team' with five bullets about uptime, latency, incident count, MTTR, and on-call load.
evals.expected_output: The slide is rewritten before building: a short claim headline, the five metrics reduced to a stat strip with one focal number (or split across slides), and the bullet prose moved to speaker notes, with the rewrite shown to the user in the outline table.
assertions: The proposed headline is seven words or fewer and states a result
The five bullets do not survive as a list on any slide
No more than four numbers share one stat strip, and one is marked focus
The omitted detail appears in <aside class="notes">

evals.prompt: Build me slides about our new architecture, but the architecture-design plugin isn't installed on this machine.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops and tells the user to install the architecture-design plugin; it does not draw diagrams by hand or fall back to Mermaid.
assertions: The response names the architecture-design plugin as a requirement
No SVG, Mermaid block, or HTML-box diagram is produced
